title: fix(console): under draft preview the New record form draws a draft-only field and never writes it
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Part of #34807
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise corrected: 6946635368
Ruling-ref: 6946403206
Surface-amendment: 6949282066
Review-ref: 6950630501

This PR ships the **form half** of the card. The list half (a draft list column on a draft-only field gets the list query refused) **stays on the card**: the console list query is sent by `ListView` in `@object-ui/plugin-list`, outside this PR's surface, and the seat is deciding how it lands.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：草稿预览（`?preview=draft`）里，「新建记录」整页表单和全局新建/编辑弹窗现在会显示只存在于草稿中的字段（用草稿里的标签和定义），但该字段是灰的、不可填写，也不算必填（草稿里标了必填也不会挡住保存）；保存时这些字段也不会写入记录。
- **为什么改**：AI 在抽屉里给应用加了字段，进入草稿预览后新建表单却看不到它，用户会以为 AI 没做成；改成「看得见、填不了」，既让预览可信，又不让用户白填一个不会被保存的值。
- **风险与回滚**：只在预览模式下生效；预览之外表单拿到的仍是原来的 adapter 本身，`plugin-form` 只多认一个预览专用标记，没有标记的字段行为不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts` 与 `ObjectForm.tsx`（`disabled` 那一行多了 `_draftOnly` 判断，影响已发布包）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/previewFormDataSource.ts`（`withDraftOnlyFields` 与代理的 `create`/`update` 剔除）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.tsx`（只换了传给表单的 dataSource）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/utils/previewFormDataSource.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.draftPreview-34807.test.tsx packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.test.ts packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.test.tsx`，预期 4 个文件、70 个测试全部通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/previewFormDataSource.ts`:
  - `withDraftOnlyFields(published, overlay)`: a copy of the **published** object document plus each field only the draft overlay declares, with its draft definition minus `required` / `requiredWhen`, and the marker **`_draftOnly: true`** (spelled in the module as `DRAFT_ONLY_FIELD_KEY`). A disabled control the form still requires would refuse every save over a field the viewer cannot fill (review 6950630501, M1). Fields the published document declares keep their published definition. The copy re-attaches the adapter's non-enumerable sortability projection with `attachObjectSortability` (a spread drops it). A draft-only object (published read answers `MetadataNotFoundError`) yields the overlay with every field marked; no overlay document returns the published one as is.
  - `readDraftPreviewObjectSchema(adapter, readOverlay, name)`: the overlay read (`useMetadata().getItem('object', name)`, which reads through the `?preview=draft` client in preview) over the adapter's published `getObjectSchema`. Any published failure other than absence fails the read, as today.
  - `createPreviewFormDataSource(adapter, readOverlay)`: a `Proxy` over the adapter whose `getObjectSchema` answers the above and whose `create` / `update` leave the draft-only names that answer marked out of the record they send (a safety net: the field is not fillable, but its declared default would otherwise ride along). Every other member is the adapter's own, bound to it once (stable identity).
  - `usePreviewFormDataSource(adapter)`: the adapter **itself** outside preview; the proxy inside it.
- `@object-ui/plugin-form`: the `disabled` line in `ObjectForm`'s `generateField` and in the shared object-schema field mapping `fromObjectSchema` (`sectionFields.ts`) gains `|| field._draftOnly === true`. In `normalizeSectionField` a form-view entry's `required` no longer applies when the object-schema field carries `_draftOnly: true` (the view entry carries no `requiredWhen` on that path); the field stays disabled. The literal is spelled in each package; nothing new is exported.
- `RecordFormPage` passes `usePreviewFormDataSource(dataSource)` to `ObjectForm`; `claimAnswerWarnings` keeps the raw adapter. Its comment now says the draft-only field is drawn disabled and the proxy leaves it out of every create and update (review S1, 6949215692: fixed).
- `AppContent` passes it to the global `LazyModalForm` (call-site change only).
- The write census in `affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx` (`WRITE_SITES`) gains the proxy's `create` and `update` as `door(...)` entries, with the reason: it forwards the write its form hands it, minus draft-only field names.
- No change to `ModalForm`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-list`, `preview/**` or `packages/**`. No new locale key.

## Why

Under `?preview=draft` the form's field **names** came from the draft-aware metadata provider, but its field **definitions** came from the adapter's published `getObjectSchema`, which carries no preview flag; `ObjectForm` draws only a name its definition declares, so a draft-only field was missing (premise reading 6946388533, corrected by the seat in 6946635368).

**Disabled, not readonly, and not editable-then-stripped (surface amendment 6949282066, route A).** Preview stays read-only for data (ruling 6946403206, ADR-0037 Phase 1): a draft-only field does not exist in the published object the data door validates against, so it must never be written. A field drawn editable and then silently stripped was rejected by the seat. Marking the definition `readonly: true` does not work: measured on this head, `filterSystemFields` in `@object-ui/plugin-form` drops any `readonly: true` field on create **and** edit, and a create form does not evaluate `readonlyWhen` (`readonlyWhen: isCreateForm ? undefined : readonlyWhen` in the components form renderer), so a static lock hides the field the preview exists to show and a predicate lock does nothing. (Correction: an earlier revision of this body named that filter `filterCreateModeFields`; the function is `filterSystemFields`.) The renderer does honour `FormField.disabled` on create, so `plugin-form` maps the marker to `disabled`.

**Disabled, therefore not required (review 6950630501, M1).** `isRequiredInForm` keeps `required` at both plugin-form mapping sites, the form renderer never lowers `required` for a disabled control, and react-hook-form still validates it, so a draft that adds a required field with no default made New refuse with "X is required" over a control the viewer cannot fill (reproduced: the ablation below). The marked copy therefore drops the field's `required` and `requiredWhen`, in app-shell. A form view could restate `required` over the field (`normalizeSectionField` re-runs `isRequiredInForm` on the view entry's own `required`, and under preview the form view comes from the draft object), so that restatement is skipped for a `_draftOnly` field in `sectionFields.ts` (fix round 4, option A). The field's value rules (`minLength`, `maxLength`, `min`, `max`, and the email / url / location checks its type implies) are kept: they fire only on a value, and the only value a disabled draft-only control holds is its own draft default, so they could refuse only a draft whose default breaks its own rule.

**Deviation, declared.** `_draftOnly` is an underscore-private convention between two of our packages (`@object-ui/app-shell` sets it, `@object-ui/plugin-form` reads it), not an authoring key: no spec schema, no metadata document and no author ever writes it, it is never persisted, and only the console's draft-preview proxy produces it. Hence `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.test.ts`: "a `_draftOnly` field maps to a disabled FormField": the marked field is `disabled`; CONTROL: the same field unmarked is not. A form-view entry `{ field: 'priority', required: true }` over the marked field gives `required: false`, `disabled: true`; CONTROL: the same entry over an unmarked field gives `required: true`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.test.tsx`: "ObjectForm draws a `_draftOnly` field disabled": through the real `ObjectForm`, the marked field's input is disabled; CONTROL: the unmarked field stays editable.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/previewFormDataSource.test.tsx` (17 tests): a required draft-only field (`required: true`, no default) and a `requiredWhen` one, through the real `ModalForm` under preview: both drawn disabled, Save goes through, the create has neither key; `withDraftOnlyFields` drops `required` / `requiredWhen` from a draft-only field and keeps a published field's `required`; CONTROL outside preview: a required published field left empty still blocks Save (`aria-invalid`, no create). Also `withDraftOnlyFields` (marker, published definitions kept, inputs untouched, sortability projection survives, draft-only object, no overlay); the proxy (overlay answer, absence vs other failure, `create`/`update` strip, `this` binding / identity / `instanceof`); the hook (CONTROL: outside preview it **is** the adapter; in preview it reads `getItem('object', name)`); the real `ModalForm` under preview: "Priority" visible and its input disabled, "Title" editable, Save's create payload has `title` and no `priority` (its declared default is stripped too); CONTROL outside preview: one `getObjectSchema('tracker_task')` call, `getItem` never called, no "Priority".
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.draftPreview-34807.test.tsx` (4 tests): the real `RecordFormPage` + `ObjectForm` under preview with a required draft-only field: drawn disabled, Save goes through, the create leaves it out. With a draft form view whose section restates `{ field: 'due_note', required: true }` on the draft-only field: drawn disabled, Save goes through, the create leaves it out. Also the real `RecordFormPage` + `ObjectForm` under preview: "Priority" visible and disabled, absent from the create; CONTROL outside preview: one published read (objectui#13044), no overlay read, no draft field.

## Acceptance notes

- Draft edits to a field the published object already declares (a relabel, a new option) are **not** shown: those fields keep their published definition so what the form validates and writes is what the data door accepts. Only draft-only fields come from the overlay.
- A draft-only field's value rules are kept (see Why): they could refuse only a draft whose own default breaks its own rule.
- A master-detail form that persists through `submitHandler` (not `dataSource.create`/`update`) is not covered by the payload strip; the field is still drawn disabled there if that form maps through `fromObjectSchema`; no draft-only path into it was found, not measured.
- Out of scope, noted not filed (read inference, not reproduced): `RecordFormPage` turns every query-string entry into a create prefill, so on a New page under `?preview=draft` the pair `preview=draft` becomes a prefill value; the write sanitizer drops it as an unknown key unless the object declares a field named `preview`.
- The list half stays on #34807 (see the top of this body).
